items.english: An aphid colony that has turned brown and papery has been killed by parasitic wasps.
items.draft: Iqela le-aphid eselijike laba mdaka-nsundu libe lithambile njengephepha lixelwe zii-parasitic wasp.
items.backtranslation: A colony that turned brown and soft as paper has been 'xelwe' (told/stung?) by wasps.
items.problem: Verb 'xela' (to tell) wrongly spelt for 'xhela' (sting) and 'killed' was lost; meaning unclear.
items.corrected: Iqela le-aphid eselijike laba mdaka-nsundu libe lingathi liphepha, libulewe zii-parasitic wasp.

items.english: Parasitic wasps are tiny and cannot sting people.
items.draft: Ii-parasitic wasp zincinci kwaye azinakubaxela abantu.
items.problem: Wrong verb spelling: 'xela' means tell; 'xhela' means sting (glossary: ukuxhelwa yinyosi). Safety-relevant statement was garbled.
items.corrected: Ii-parasitic wasp zincinci kwaye azinakubaxhela abantu.

items.english: Farmers in China grew a small floating fern with their rice for centuries
pushed 3 to 5 cm into the soil
items.draft: ityiwe emhlabeni nge-3 ukuya kwi-5 cm
items.problem: 'ityiwe' is the passive of -tya (to eat); wrong verb.
items.corrected: ifakwe emhlabeni nge-3 ukuya kwi-5 cm

items.english: Keep them off young seedlings, which they scratch up.
items.draft: Zigcine kude nezithombo ezincinci, kuba ziyaluxovula.
items.problem: Wrong verb and concord (trample/knead, not scratch up).
items.corrected: Zigcine kude nezithombo ezincinci, kuba ziyazikrwexa zize zizikhuphe.
